title: Confirmed PUB400 sign-on and password-expiry flow
summary: The confirmed PUB400 recovery sequence is SIGNON -> PASSWORD_EXPIRED_NOTICE -> CHANGE_PASSWORD -> MAIN_MENU, with one explicit Enter between each transition. The earlier permissive direct SIGNON -> CHANGE_PASSWORD shortcut is not authoritative.
invariants: Do not infer or skip a live host transition.
Unexpected screens receive no next command.
Password values are staged only after exact IBM_I_CHANGE_PASSWORD matching.
After successful password change, IBM_I_MAIN_MENU is the required semantic state before signoff.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
